top_module.name: motor_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level CSR-controlled aerodynamics safety controller. It accepts configuration and launch events, packages bounded model requests, arbitrates transport handshakes to an external service, supervises freshness and timeout, validates response content, clamps actuator outputs, and drives a sticky safe fallback state on any fault condition.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete safe control wrapper around an external automotive-aerodynamics service. The module exposes a compact CSR plane for configuration and status, accepts a start event with seq_id and cmd_age_ticks, packages a bounded request descriptor from geometry base address/length/format and configured velocity, performs handshake-based request/response transport, supervises freshness and timeout, validates response format, extracts only compact command-relevant fields, applies min/max saturation and slew-rate limiting, and asserts a deterministic safe fallback actuator state on any fault, malformed response, stale input, transport error, abort, or timeout. The module preserves sticky status bits and only clears fault state through explicit host-controlled clear-fault behavior when safe.
responsibilities: Own the top-level CSR register map and deterministic readback behavior.
Capture configuration only when valid and not busy, except clear-fault semantics.
Generate bounded request descriptors rather than streaming bulk geometry.
Drive request/response valid-ready transport handshakes to the external model service.
Supervise freshness and detect stale commands and non-monotonic seq_id values.
Enforce timeout and invoke fallback locally without relying on remote model correctness.
Clamp actuator outputs to configured min/max and slew-rate limits.
Assert sticky fault and status indicators for busy, done, fault, timeout, stale, clamped, fallback_active, transport_error, and response_valid.
must_not_drive: physics inference outputs beyond bounded request/response control fields
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, the module returns to IDLE with csr_ready asserted for idle bus acceptance, all sticky fault and status bits cleared, model request/response handshakes deasserted, command outputs forced to the deterministic safe state, and configuration registers set to benign defaults or invalid-unconfigured state until programmed by the host.
behavior_rules: Only accept CSR writes when csr_valid and csr_we are asserted, the bus is ready, and the controller is not busy, except that clear_fault may clear sticky fault state when the implementation deems it safe.
Only assert model_req_valid after start, configuration valid, no pending fault, and freshness checks pass.

Generate a bounded 128-bit request payload that includes seq_id, geometry base address, geometry length, geometry format tag, stream velocity, service opcode, checkpoint/version tag, and control flags in a fixed format.
Wait for model_rsp_valid with model_rsp_ready asserted only during WAIT_RSP; if response does not arrive before timeout expiration, assert timeout fault and enter fallback.
Reject stale input when cmd_age_ticks exceeds freshness_limit or seq_id is not newer than the last accepted sequence number.
Reject malformed descriptor, unsupported geometry format, illegal velocity setting, and transport protocol error by entering FALLBACK or FAULT and asserting sticky fault bits.
Response parsing shall use only bounded fixed-format command-relevant fields; full flow fields and pressure maps are not surfaced at top level.
Command clamping shall always apply min/max saturation and slew-rate limiting before driving cmd_value and cmd_rate.
cmd_valid shall be asserted only when no safety violation is active; when fallback is active, safe_mode shall be asserted and fault shall remain sticky until cleared by host software.

modules.name: motor_control_register_map
modules.description: CSR decode and register bank for control, status, and summary fields. It stores only compact configuration and readback state, exposes semantic configuration outputs, and provides deterministic read data to the top-level CSR bus.
modules.functionality: Decodes the compact register map, stores configuration registers, provides launch and clear-fault pulses, and returns deterministic status and response-summary values. It never stores or exposes bulk geometry or flow payloads.
responsibilities: Implement required control, status, launch, clear_fault, and response summary registers.
Provide semantic configuration outputs to downstream control logic.
Update configuration only when valid and not busy, except for clear-fault semantics.
Return deterministic read data for all supported CSR addresses.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets register contents to benign defaults, clears launch and clear-fault pulses, and returns deterministic readback values while configuration is invalid until written.
behavior_rules: Writes update configuration only when the bus handshake is accepted and the controller is not busy, except that clear_fault_pulse may be issued to request sticky fault clearing.
Sequence, timeout, freshness, velocity, geometry address/length/format, actuator limits, slew limit, checkpoint tag, and control flags must be stored as compact scalar registers only.
Response summary is read-only and reflects bounded command-relevant information only.
No wide data structures, arrays, or inferred memories may be used for CSR storage.

modules.name: payload_pointer_manager
modules.description: Stores only compact geometry pointer metadata, size, format, alignment, and validity checks. It does not store the actual geometry payload in flip-flops and acts only as a bounded descriptor source.
modules.functionality: Latches only pointer metadata and performs bounded alignment and validity checks for the geometry descriptor. It does not contain bulk payload data or geometry interpretation logic.
responsibilities: Store geometry base address, length, and format tag only.
Perform alignment checks and flag invalid descriptors.
Provide a stable geometry descriptor source for request packaging.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears stored pointer metadata, asserts invalid descriptor status until updated, and resets alignment status.
behavior_rules: Only compact pointer, size, and format metadata may be stored.
No bulk geometry content may be captured in registers or inferred memories.
Alignment and validity checks must be purely scalar and bounded.

modules.name: request_packager
modules.description: Constructs the bounded transport request descriptor from seq_id, geometry metadata, flow operating point, checkpoint/version tag, and control flags.
modules.functionality: Encodes a fixed-format, bounded 128-bit request for the external model service. It includes sequence number, geometry pointer and length, geometry format, velocity, service opcode, checkpoint tag, and control flags, and only issues requests when descriptor and freshness checks pass.
responsibilities: Package the exact request fields required by the external service contract.
Prevent request launch when descriptor validity or freshness checks fail.
Provide a request accepted indication for downstream control sequencing.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears request valid and accepted flags, returns an inactive payload, and waits for fresh, valid launch conditions.
behavior_rules: Request construction must remain bounded and fixed-format.
No model inference or geometry expansion is permitted in RTL.
The request may be asserted only when start, descriptor_valid, and freshness_ok are all true.

modules.name: transport_controller
modules.description: Implements the valid-ready transport bridge to the external GPU-hosted service, including issue, wait, timeout, and error propagation.
modules.functionality: Drives request issuance, waits for a fixed-format response, raises timeout and transport error indicators, and extracts only a bounded response summary for downstream validation and CSR readback.
responsibilities: Manage request and response valid-ready handshakes.
Track timeout expiration in ticks.
Expose a compact response summary only, not full flow fields or maps.
Assert transport error and timeout indicators on protocol failures.
modules.reset_behavior: Returns to idle, deasserts handshake outputs, clears busy/done/error indicators, and clears response summary content.
behavior_rules: Only one in-flight request is permitted at a time unless explicitly extended by the top-level control policy.
If response does not arrive before timeout expiration, assert timeout fault and propagate fallback semantics upstream.
Response summary must be a bounded, fixed-format extraction of command-relevant fields only.

modules.name: freshness_timeout_supervisor
modules.description: Rejects stale commands, enforces sequence monotonicity, and supervises timeout aging for command launch.
modules.functionality: Compares input sequence and command age against configured freshness thresholds and tracks the latest accepted sequence number. It rejects stale or non-monotonic commands and provides freshness qualification to request packaging and launch control.
responsibilities: Detect stale command age beyond configured threshold.
Reject non-newer sequence numbers relative to the last accepted sequence number.
Provide timeout configuration validity checks.
Expose freshness qualification as a single-bit control signal.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears last accepted sequence tracking and deasserts freshness qualification until a valid command is seen.
behavior_rules: Freshness rejection is local RTL policy and does not depend on the remote service.
Sequence monotonicity must be enforced using scalar comparison only.
Timeout configuration must be bounded and treated as invalid if zero or otherwise unsupported.

modules.name: response_parser
modules.description: Accepts only bounded fixed-format service responses and extracts compact command-relevant fields for validation and CSR readback.
modules.functionality: Checks response framing and extracts only bounded fixed-format command fields relevant to the actuator command path. It rejects malformed responses and never exposes full flow fields, pressure maps, or other high-dimensional model outputs.
responsibilities: Validate response framing and expected sequence identity.
Extract bounded command-relevant output fields only.
Detect malformed or unsupported responses.
modules.reset_behavior: Clears parsed fields and response validity, and waits for a fresh well-formed response.
behavior_rules: Only fixed-format bounded responses are accepted.
Expected sequence ID must match the response for acceptance.
Malformed responses must force fallback and fault indication downstream.

modules.name: command_clamper
modules.description: Applies min/max saturation and slew-rate limiting to derive final actuator command values.
modules.functionality: Performs deterministic saturation and slew-rate limiting on compact actuator command fields. It always clamps outputs regardless of response content and produces a clamped indicator when any limit is active.
responsibilities: Saturate command value between configured min and max.
Apply slew-rate limiting to the command rate.
Assert clamped when any clamp condition is applied.
modules.reset_behavior: Forces outputs to the safe deterministic command state and clears clamped status until a valid command is processed.
behavior_rules: Clamping must be applied regardless of response content.
No output may exceed configured min/max or slew limits.
Only compact scalar arithmetic is permitted.

modules.name: safe_fallback_controller
modules.description: Provides deterministic safe actuator settings and sticky fault behavior for all fault, timeout, stale, malformed response, host abort, or transport error conditions.
modules.functionality: Implements a deterministic safe aerodynamic setting and sticky fault propagation. It drives safe outputs whenever any safety violation or transport anomaly occurs and maintains sticky fault state until cleared by host software under safe conditions.
responsibilities: Generate predefined safe-state actuator outputs.
Assert fallback_active and safe_mode on any fault condition.
Maintain sticky fault until explicit clear_fault behavior is permitted.
modules.reset_behavior: Initializes to the predefined safe actuator setting with safe_mode and fallback_active deasserted until a fault or launch event requires fallback.
behavior_rules: Any fault, timeout, stale input, malformed response, host abort, or transport error forces fallback.
Fault state must be sticky until cleared by host software.
Safe output values must be deterministic and local to RTL.

modules.name: motor_control_fsm
modules.description: Top-level synchronous state machine coordinating IDLE, ISSUE_REQ, WAIT_RSP, VALIDATE, CLAMP, APPLY, FALLBACK, and FAULT states.
modules.functionality: Coordinates the controller sequencing and sticky fault escalation. It evaluates launch and qualification conditions, advances through the required states, and asserts busy/done/fault outputs consistently with safety policy.
responsibilities: Implement the required IDLE, ISSUE_REQ, WAIT_RSP, VALIDATE, CLAMP, APPLY, FALLBACK, and FAULT states.
Ensure all transitions are synchronous and reset-safe.
Prevent unsafe application when faults, freshness violations, or malformed responses are present.
modules.reset_behavior: Returns to IDLE with all state outputs deasserted and fault cleared only by reset; sticky fault clearing is handled through explicit control path.
behavior_rules: All state transitions must be synchronous to clk.
Fallback must be entered on any safety violation or transport anomaly.
State outputs are purely indicative and must never bypass local safety checks.
